user_sees: Sheet 'Add measures', 'Fill in any you like.', a 'Date' row on today
Boxes 'Body weight', 'Body fat', 'Neck', 'Shoulders', 'Chest', 'Arm', 'Forearm', 'Waist', 'Hips', 'Thigh', 'Calf' with their units (kg, %, cm)
must_not: Length boxes in inches when the app is set to kg and cm

steps.action: Type Waist 82.5 and Body fat 18,2 (comma), tap 'Save'
user_sees: The sheet closes; chip 'Waist' shows a graph point and the latest value '82.5 cm'
must_not: The value stored rounded to a whole number

steps.action: Log the waist again on a later day
user_sees: The line under the latest value, like '−1.5 cm since 12 Mar 2026'
must_not: The change measured against the wrong entry (it is since the first one)

start: Progress tab, the member taps a waist tile (opens Body on the waist chip)

steps.action: Open Body from the Progress link for waist
user_sees: Body opened on the 'Waist' chip when waist has entries, else on the first measure with entries
must_not: An empty chip picked when other measures have entries

steps.action: A gym member whose trainer recorded a chest measurement opens the 'Chest' chip
user_sees: History line 'Tap your own entry to fix or delete it. Ask your gym to change the ones they recorded.'
must_not: The gym's entry opening a Fix sheet

user_sees: 'Nothing to save' 'Type at least one measure, or add a picture.'

steps.action: Type 'abc' in Neck and 0 in Arm, tap 'Save'
user_sees: 'Check the numbers' 'Neck, Arm: type a number above 0, like 82.5.'
must_not: The good boxes saved while the bad ones are dropped without a word

user_sees: A message that body fat must be 100 % or less
must_not: 150 % body fat saved and drawn on the chart

start: Body screen, Waist chip, an entry on 10 Nov

steps.action: Add a waist value again for 10 Nov
user_sees: 'That day already has these. Saving replaces them.'

steps.action: Tap the 10 Nov entry in History, change the date to a day that already has one
user_sees: Sheet 'Fix this waist entry' with 'Measurement date'
'<date> already has Waist <value>' 'Replace it with this one?' with 'Replace'
must_not: The other day's entry overwritten without asking

user_sees: 'Waist on <date> deleted' with 'Undo'; after Undo the entry is back
must_not: Undo bringing back a different value
The entry gone for good with no undo
